subject: Post-discovery: coordinate 75-90m ML/Infra immersion — dates & agenda

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: coordinate 75-90m ML/Infra immersion — dates & agenda

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: BluePeak is focused on reducing inference spend for batch scoring of personalization models and improving tail latency for interactive recommendations. You mentioned the core constraints (PCI-adjacent data, VPC requirement, existing TF->ONNX conversion pipeline) and that the best next step is a technical immersion with your ML infra and ops engineers.

Suggested format: 75–90 minutes with our ML infra engineer + solutions architect. High-level agenda attached, and a one-page mutual action plan we can walk through during the call. Proposed agenda highlights:
- 10m: Quick recap of goals and success metrics
- 20m: Current infra + bottlenecks (BluePeak)
- 25m: Redwood serving architecture & compatibility checklist
- 20m: Mapping integration points, security constraints, and rollout options
- 10m: Next steps & mutual action items

Open slots (PST):
- Tue Apr 13, 11:00–12:30
- Wed Apr 14, 09:30–11:00
- Thu Apr 15, 14:00–15:30

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side will join (ML lead, infra/ops, security)? I’ve attached the agenda and MAP for quick review.

Happy to adjust length if you prefer 60m.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood_ml-immersion-agenda.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the clear recap. All sounds right. Marc (cc’d) will be the ML infra lead and I’ll include our security PM (TBD) if they’re available. Of the slots you sent, we prefer Wed Apr 14 09:30–11:00 PST. If we need a little extra time we can stretch to 90m — that works.

Two asks before we lock:
1) Can you confirm who from Redwood will be on the call (role + focus)?
2) We have a pre-call checklist request: list of environment details to gather (model formats, existing inference stack, expected QPS, PII/data sensitivity notes). If Ben can prep that checklist it’ll speed things up.

Thanks — looking forward to the dive.

— Alex

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Thanks for looping me in. Confirming I’ll join on Apr 14 (Ben Carter). I’m putting together a short pre-call checklist and a one-page environment snapshot we’d like BluePeak to have available. Draft checklist below — happy to compact if you prefer 60m:

Pre-call checklist (draft):
- Model artifacts: framework & formats (TF saved_model, TorchScript, ONNX)
- Typical sequence length / input payload size examples
- Current serving stack (components: model server, queue, autoscaler)
- Typical QPS and 95/99 latency targets under load
- Data sensitivity notes (PII/PCI/PHI flags) and if traffic must stay in a VPC
- Access patterns for batch scoring vs online inference
- Any pre-existing quantization/optimization (awq, q4f16, etc.)

Attachments: pre-call-checklist.pdf (short), I’ll also drop a link to a small sample config we use for similar customers during the meeting.

If you can add your security PM when available that’ll help with the VPC/KMS conversation.

See you on the 14th — I’ll prepare a short demo of serving runtime behavior and a compatibility checklist we can use to scope integration work.

Ben Carter
Senior ML Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0224
